processor.name: Reticle
processor.story: Reticle: images that are circuits. Every image is a NAND circuit and renders from its own eval, wallet-free and gas-free for viewers. Ink = transistors. Supply cap 1,048,576 (shared NAND/LATCH), price 0.00003 OKB each, no other cap, immutable at deploy. One transistor burns per gate at tapeout. Mint proceeds go to the creator via owed()/withdraw(). Built on TapeOut upgradeable beacon contracts, unaudited.

previousRenderers.note: replaced: svg() built its string with quadratic memory growth and exceeded the 50M eth_call gas cap
